seed.tooltip: Current seed. The browser extension updates this value after each queue according to the selected mode.

PersistentSeedSequence.name: PersistentSeedSequence
PersistentSeedSequence.description: Outputs the current seed as an integer. A browser extension advances the seed after each queue according to the selected mode (fixed / increment / decrement / randomize-after-queue) and shows the value that was just used as 'last_seed'.
